header: Four things built in from the start
subheadline: Dark mode, icons, modern CSS and accessibility basics come with the system. Your project's content and testing are still part of the launch.

items.title: Dark mode built in
items.description_text: Light, dark and auto modes use one set of tokens. You need no second stylesheet.

items.title: 5 icon libraries
items.description_text: Lucide, Tabler, HugeIcons, Phosphor or Remix Icon. One setting switches between them.

items.title: Tailwind v4 + OKLCH
items.description_text: Modern colour tokens and container queries, set up and ready for production.

items.title: WCAG 2.2 contrast checks
items.description_text: Contrast is tested for every theme preset. Whether a finished page conforms still depends on its content and integrations.
